name: EXP-TEST-005 Every test file has an owner
goal:
Every test file must have an owner. Today 115 of the 242 files in tests/ are executed by nothing.

MEASURED INVENTORY (2026-10-13, branch arena/841cc45d-synth, commit 2fc7969)
`test:all` does not list files: its command is a chain of `npm run test:X`, each resolving to a task in
data/tasks/ whose own command runs the files. Resolving that transitively (scripts -> task ids -> dependsOn
-> commands), with no unresolvable task ids:
  * 242 test files exist
  * 127 are reachable from test:all
  * 115 are NOT reachable: 108 have no test:<name> script at all, and 7 have a script but are not in the
    chain (agent-sdk, ai-capability-projection, governance-orchestration, mcp-server, package-distribution,
    release, synth-cli-govern-explain)
  * tests/migration.test.js is the eighth unreachable-but-unswept file: no script, not chained. The word
    "migration" appears in test:all.task.json only inside its description text, never in an executed command.

All 107 scriptless orphans were executed in a throwaway copy of the repo (never against the live ledger):
  * 36 RED, 71 GREEN, 0 timeouts
  * control: the 42 swept files that ARE reachable from the chain were all green, so `npm run govern` is not
    red today - the rot is entirely outside the chain, which is exactly why nobody saw it
  * the 71 green orphans contain 2190 assert call-sites. Exactly one is a stub with zero assertions
    (bootstrap-discovery-integration, 550 bytes). So this is not mostly dead weight: roughly 2190 assertions
    of real coverage run nowhere and can break silently at any commit.

THE AUTHORITATIVE PLAN IS WRONG, AND AN APPROVED EXPEDITION IS BUILT ON IT
docs/plans/testing-and-reporting-infrastructure-review.md section 4.2 is titled "Inventory (242 files, 114 in
chain, 14 missing)" and section 4.3 reasons from "stale: 14 missing". Measured: 127 reachable, 115
unreachable. The doc accounted for 14 unaccounted files; the real number is 115, so it undercounts by 101.
EXP-TEST-002 ("Merge suites 114->~70", approved f6420030064a6f70) is scoped to implement that doc's decision
matrix - merging mission-studio 8->3, discovery 8->2, adapter 16->4, environment 5->4 - against an inventory
that cannot see 101 files. Merging on top of a wrong inventory destroys coverage nobody has counted. A
hand-maintained inventory is also how it went wrong: it must be generated.

DELIVERABLES
  1. A generator that walks the task graph and emits a checked-in inventory artifact giving, for every
     tests/*.test.js: reachable-from-test:all (yes/no), owning script/task ids, last observed status,
     assertion count, dist-import signature and cluster. Deterministic and re-runnable; the artifact is
     derived, never hand-edited.
  2. A file-level ownership guard: no test file may exist without an owner - reachable from test:all, or
     explicitly standalone with a recorded reason, or retired with a recorded reason. On violation it names
     every offender. EXP-TEST-002 promises a guard that every test:* TASK is in test:all or marked
     standalone; that is task-level and cannot see the 108 files that have no task. This guard is file-level.
  3. A recorded disposition for all 115 unreachable files - wire in, merge, retire, or fix - with the
     evidence for each, and the 7 scripted-but-unchained ones wired or explicitly retired first (cheapest).
  4. Triage and resolution of the 36 red suites, excluding the three product defects owned by draft
     03f9134a5ecbde03 (default bootstrap never discovers a legacy-only event log; the verify barrel omits
     RuleBasedCapabilityVerifier; materialize returns an eventLogPath it never creates). Coordinate, do not
     duplicate: if 03f9134a lands first, three of the 36 are already green.
  5. The 5 nowhere-in-src symbols adjudicated individually, in writing, as retired-capability or
     lost-capability.
  6. Section 4.2/4.3 of the plan doc corrected to the generated numbers, with the generator named as the
     source of truth.

NON-GOALS
  * Do not execute EXP-TEST-002's merges. This expedition produces the corrected inventory, the guard and the
    per-file dispositions that make those merges safe; TEST-002 then executes them. TEST-005 should run first.
  * Do not do EXP-TEST-001 (logging/failure envelope), EXP-TEST-003 (parallelization) or EXP-TEST-004
    (explicit environment). The two unbuilt-package suites are evidence FOR TEST-004, not work for this one.
  * Do not fix the three product defects in draft 03f9134a5ecbde03.
  * Do not delete a failing test to reach green, and do not mark a suite standalone to make the guard quiet.
    Retirement and standalone both require a recorded reason, and a red suite may only be retired if the
    capability it guarded is genuinely gone.
  * Do not weaken an assertion to make a red suite green. Where the test is right and the product is wrong,
    the product changes or a defect expedition is filed.

ACCEPTANCE
  * The generator reproduces the inventory deterministically, and its numbers match section 4.2 of the doc.
  * The ownership guard fails on a deliberately orphaned file added in a test, and passes on the real tree.
  * Every one of the 115 unreachable files has a recorded disposition; none is unaccounted.
  * Each of the 36 red suites is green, retired-with-reason, or filed as a product defect with an expedition
    or draft id - no fourth outcome.
  * `npm run govern` executes the newly wired suites and is green.
  * No regression in the 127 currently reachable files.
